title: Self-Recording With AI Coaching
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting self-recording with ai coaching to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Interpret AI speech-coaching metrics (pace, filler count, clarity) as gameable proxies for the listener's experience, not as goals.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Apply one-change-per-take, single-variable practice and confirm each metric gain with a human listener.
Document accepted, modified, and rejected AI coach suggestions in the critique log with reasons.
